job.title: Scheduling Manager
job.description:
Preconstruction & Baseline Scheduling
  • Work closely with the Preconstruction team to develop preliminary project schedules during the estimating and preconstruction phases.
  • Assist in developing project schedules that align with contractual requirements, project milestones, procurement requirements, and the overall project execution strategy.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Superintendents to develop detailed baseline schedules following project award.
  • Establish consistent scheduling standards, templates, calendars, coding structures, and scheduling procedures across the company.
  • Review baseline schedules for logic, sequencing, durations, milestones, procurement activities, and overall constructability.
  • Assist project teams in identifying critical path activities and key schedule milestones.
Project Scheduling & Forecasting
  • Work directly with Project Managers and Superintendents to maintain accurate and current project schedules.
  • Support project teams with regular schedule updates and progress tracking.
  • Assist teams in developing realistic forecasts for project completion and major milestones.
  • Identify schedule variances and trends and work with project teams to develop recovery strategies when necessary.
  • Monitor critical path activities and proactively identify potential schedule impacts.
  • Analyze schedule performance and communicate risks, opportunities, and areas requiring attention to project leadership.
  • Help ensure project schedules accurately reflect current field conditions and project expectations.
Project Team Collaboration
  • Serve as a scheduling resource and partner to Project Managers, Superintendents, and project teams.
  • Attend project planning and scheduling meetings as needed.
  • Facilitate schedule reviews with project teams and help translate schedule data into actionable information.
  • Work collaboratively with project teams rather than operating as a separate scheduling function.
  • Provide training and coaching to PMs, Superintendents, and other team members on scheduling best practices.
  • Promote a culture of proactive planning, accountability, and schedule ownership throughout the organization.
Company-Wide Scheduling Management
  • Maintain visibility into the overall schedule performance of the company's active project portfolio.
